Marta (Customer): Hi team — after the model swap this morning our webhook JSON parser started throwing errors. We only changed the model version (pinned to `prod-llama-3-2.1`) and then started seeing parse failures in production (hundreds/minute).

Jordan (CS): Sorry to hear that — can you paste a raw sample response body and the error your parser shows? Also when did you start seeing this (approx ts)?

Marta (Customer): Started around 1965001200 UTC, right after the canary finished. Here's a minimal curl we used and the raw body returned by Redwood: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"prod-llama-3-2.1","input":"extract: orders"}'

Raw response body (exact bytes we received):

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

// generated_by: instruction-tuner v2
{
  "Result": {
    "order_id": 12345,
    "status": "shipped",
  },
  "meta": {
    "legacyId": "ORD-12345"
  },
}
```

Marta (Customer): Our server's JSON parser fails on that body — it sees the leading "//" comment line and the trailing commas and also casing changes on keys (we expect lowercased keys). Example parser error: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 3 column 1 (char 28)`

DeployBot: Canary swap completed: rolled model prod-llama-3-2.1 to customer-east-1 at 1965001003.

Alyssa (Support): Thanks for the sample, @Marta — that's super helpful. Two quick q's: are you using streaming mode or non-streaming? Do you have any postprocessors that assume keys are lowercase?

Marta (Customer): Non-streaming. We do strict schema validation: all keys expected to be snake_case lowercased. The validator is failing hard and drops events into a DLQ.

Samir (Eng): I'm looking into this. The leading `//` and trailing commas are not valid JSON — model should not emit comments. Can you also paste the prompt we send (no PII)? Want to repro locally.

Marta (Customer): Prompt we send is simple: "Please return a JSON object with keys: order_id, status, legacy_id". No extra instructions. Repro steps: 1) call Redwood API with the payload above 2) observe response body

Stack trace from our parser (Python stdlib):
```
File "main.py", line 42, in handle
  payload = json.loads(response_text)
File "/usr/lib/python3.10/json/__init__.py", line 346, in loads
  return _default_decoder.decode(s)
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 3 column 3 (char 30)
```

Alyssa (Support): Ok we've reproduced a similar raw body locally using the same model tag. Temporary mitigations while we triage: 1) pin to previous version `prod-llama-3-2.0` (rollback) 2) if you must accept this model, run a pre-parse cleanup that strips leading comment lines and removes trailing commas (ugly but will unblock). We'll aim to fix on our side asap.

Samir (Eng): Initial root cause hypothesis: a prompt-tuning artifact inserted annotation tokens that are rendered as line-comment sequences (`//`) by the tokenizer's detokenizer for certain outputs, plus an extra post-formatting step added trailing commas when the model output finished mid-object. Also noticed the model is emitting PascalCase keys for some legacy fields ("Result", "legacyId") — likely from a new decoding bias introduced in the fine-tune. I'm opening an internal ticket and a hotfix branch to enforce JSON-only outputs in the postprocess layer (strip comments, remove trailing commas, and normalize key casing).

Samir (Eng): Action items for eng-runtime: roll a hotfix to postprocess outputs for structured_output mode that: 1) removes leading comment-like token sequences 2) runs a tolerant-json-cleaner (attempt to auto-fix trailing commas) 3) normalizes key names to snake_case when a schema is provided. I'll target a patch today.

Alyssa (Support): Escalated to engineering. Created INC-2345 and assigned to @Samir. ETA: hotfix candidate staged for testing in canary within 6 hours, rollback path (pin to 2.0) available now. I'll follow up in this thread with the canary link and exact pin command. :thumbsup:

Jordan (CS): Noted — @Marta please confirm once you pin to prod-llama-3-2.0 that your errors stop, so we can decide rollback vs hotfix priority.

Marta (Customer): Pinning now to 2.0 — will report back in 10m. Thanks for quick response.

Alyssa (Support): Next steps documented: 1) Customer pinned to 2.0 (mitigation) 2) Eng to deploy postprocess hotfix (remove comments/trailing-commas/normalize keys) 3) QA to validate against our structured-output testset to avoid regressions.

Samir (Eng): Follow-up root cause note for the ticket: the new model's supervised data included human annotations with a leading comment token used for internal tool metadata. Under beam-ish decoding, those tokens sometimes surface as `//` in the first line. We will blacklist that token sequence in the detokenizer and add a tolerant-cleaning step to the runtime to avoid client-visible invalid JSON.

Alyssa (Support): Keeping thread open until hotfix verified. I'll post canary link and final status here. If anyone sees a similar symptom, please DM and reference INC-2345.

Marta (Customer): Confirmed — after pin to 2.0 errors dropped to 0. Will monitor. Thanks all. :pray:
